issue: `slugify()` must return lowercase slugs with words joined by single hyphens and no leading or trailing hyphens. Right now slugify('Hello World') returns 'Hello-World', and runs of spaces or punctuation produce several hyphens in a row.
prompt_template:
Bug report for the project in {workdir}:

`slugify()` must return lowercase slugs with words joined by single hyphens and no leading or trailing hyphens. Right now slugify('Hello World') returns 'Hello-World', and runs of spaces or punctuation produce several hyphens in a row.

Fix the bug in the source code (not the tests). Run the tests with `pytest -q`. When you're done, reply with a short summary of what you changed and whether the tests pass.
